answer.reason: The verses tell of Abiathar's escape from Nob, his support of Adonijah, and his removal from the priesthood by Solomon.

clauses.english: escaped the slaughter of the priests at Nob and fled to David
clauses.quote: named Abiathar, escaped, and fled after David.

clauses.english: helped Adonijah in his bid to be king
was thrust out of the priesthood by Solomon and sent to Anathoth
clauses.quote: So Solomon thrust out Abiathar from being priest unto the LORD

doubts: MRK 2:26 (Abiathar in the days of David's eating the shewbread) was left out as it states no deed of his own.
1SA 23:6 and 1SA 30:7 (bringing the ephod to David) were left out as minor details, and the ark episode in 2SA 15 as a small part of a longer event.
